credits.name: AirLLM
credits.role: layer-streamed inference and streamed LoRA training

repos.description: Native engine checkout; c/coli, not a second pip-installed coli script.
Shared agent runtime; pyproject supplies fastapi, uvicorn, psutil and colibri-agent.
Coding-agent web/PWA assets served by the shared core.
IDE integration; plugin packaging is a separate step.

desktop.description: Electron desktop with shared agent and web UI; pip deps are the local STT sidecar.

coding-agent.description: Local inference plus shared coding-agent server and web UI; pip deps are the local STT sidecar.

jetbrains.description: Local engine and agent for the IDE plugin; pip deps are the local STT sidecar.

speech.description: Local speech-to-text sidecar (faster-whisper CPU) for the core and PWA; av<18 because PyAV 18 removed metadata_errors.

npu.description: Optional NPU embeddings, NOT native model decoding.

fine-tune.description: Explicit opt-in to large training dependencies.

mobile.description: Shared core + PWA on the same device (Termux phone or desktop); the local engine starts on demand; pip deps are the local STT sidecar.
